title: fitc4 configuration
description: Paths are resolved relative to this file. Provider arrays are available in the fitc4.config.ts/.js module forms; the JSON form carries only these fields.

version.description: Config format version. An unknown version is an error, not a silent default.

repositoryRoot.description: Repository root, relative to this file. Every reported path is relative to it.

scanRoots.description: Repository-relative directories under architecture control. A missing, misspelled, or source-free root is an error rather than an empty pass; a blank string would put the entire repository under scan and is rejected.

tsconfig.description: tsconfig supplying compiler options (paths, baseUrl) for module resolution. Point this at your project's real tsconfig — a path that cannot be read fails the scan loudly.

viewerBaseUrl.description: Optional base URL of a published LikeC4 viewer (likec4 build). When set, every finding in --json carries a link into the viewer and the report footer names the base URL. End it with #/ if the viewer was built with --use-hash-history.

severity.description: Per-rule severity overrides for the default architecture rules. The standard severities assume adoption: new unowned code is a warning nudge, not a broken build. A team done adopting writes { "unmapped-source": "error" }. In a module config this cannot be combined with a 'validate' array, which replaces the provider it tunes.
error fails the gate, warning and info do not.
